research_interests.title: Interests and Goals
research_interests.description: I am a high school student majoring in Mathematics, with strengths in self-directed learning and analytical problem-solving. Adapting to a competitive academic environment in Hanoi helped me develop discipline and independent learning, and led to my achievement as a national valedictorian in grade 11. I aim to build a strong foundation in Maths and AI. In the long term, I want to create efficient, practical solutions that improve decision-making and everyday life.

bullet_points.description: Took part in the selective IMSC in China and other mathematics summer programs in Vietnam and abroad.
Engaged with world-class professors and collaborated with top students from diverse backgrounds.
Broadened my perspective on problem-solving and strengthened communication and teamwork skills.
Attended advanced training courses at VIASM.
